Lulu Sun ( Chinese : 孙璐璐 ; pinyin : Sūn Lùlù , née Lulu Radovcic ; born 14 April 2001) is a New Zealand professional tennis player. She has a career-high singles ranking of world No. 39 by the WTA , achieved on 9 September 2024 and a best doubles ranking of No. 190, reached on 24 February 2025. Early and personal life [ edit ] Sun was born Lulu Radovcic [ a ] ( Croatian : Radovčić ) in Te Anau , New Zealand, to a Chinese mother and a Croatian father. Sun briefly lived in Shanghai thereafter. [ 6 ] From the age of five she was raised in Geneva, Switzerland, where she completed her school education while still visiting New Zealand to visit family.
